verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure for agents, so versioning and rolling back automation configuration is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never documents automation versioning, change review, or rollback. The Draft human-review feature covers individual outgoing messages, not automation definitions, so it is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
